docs.title: AUB — American University of Beirut
docs.body:
# American University of Beirut (AUB)

## Faculty

AUB offers ~46 undergraduate programs across six faculties.

### Maroun Semaan Faculty of Engineering & Architecture ([MSFEA](https://www.aub.edu.lb/msfea))

| Program | Degree | Department | Credits | Years |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Architecture | BArch | School of Architecture and Design | 174 | 5 |
| Civil Engineering | BE | Civil and Environmental Engineering | 150 | 4 |

## Tuition (AY 2026-2027)

Tuition is **$1,000 per credit** for engineering programs.

## Contacts

Admissions office: admissions@aub.edu.lb

docs.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
docs.body:
# Fulbright Foreign Student Program

## Overview

Fulbright funds master's and PhD study in the United States for Lebanese graduates.

## Application window

Applications open in **February** and close in **May**.
